title: UK ETS aviation EMP variation and change-notification QA controls

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for aviation: how to comply

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS

facts.source_fact: Non-significant EMP changes must be notified through METS by 31 December in the year planned or made.
A significant EMP change should be submitted as a variation at least 14 days before the change where practicable.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve advance-application rule and practicability exception.

facts.source_fact: Changing emission-factor values is listed as a significant change.
Changing the methodology used to calculate an emission factor is listed as significant.
Changing fuel-use monitoring methodology is listed as significant.
Introducing a new fuel type, including SAF, is listed as significant.
facts.expected_handling: Do not add new fuel without EMP change control.

facts.source_fact: Changing small-emitter status or crossing a simplified-reporting threshold is listed as significant.
A legal-entity name change requires an application through METS at least 14 days before where practicable.
If the current EMP would lead to incomplete data, monitoring may need to be documented under both current and proposed variations until approval.
Business reorganisation must be notified to the regulator and registry administrator and may require a varied or new EMP.

guard_patterns.handling: Recheck simplified-reporting status after threshold change.
Preserve both current/proposed monitoring where required.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
